contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Display Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Display troubleshooting

steps: Carefully inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.
Check the Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI) by turning off the device, ejecting the SIM/MicroSD tray, and shining a flashlight into the slot.
Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger and let it charge for at least 1 hour.
Wait for up to 10 minutes for the battery charging indicator to appear on the display.
Disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Try to turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds.
Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, remove the battery for 60 seconds, and then reinsert it.
